reviewSamples.author: Ted Chard
reviewSamples.text:
This was my first visit to see Mary and Kelley. They did a wonderful grooming job with Buddy.
You can tell that they love animals as soon as you walk through the door. Highly recommend their services.

reviewSamples.author: Mera T
reviewSamples.text: What an awesome duo! They are so wonderful, loving, and more! They love dogs as much as I love my own. My baby came out so cute and HAPPY! I can’t wait to come back!!

reviewSamples.author: JenniferVD
reviewSamples.text: They do a fantastic job on our mini Poodle! Absolutely the nicest and most caring groomers and our little guy loves to go to his "spa." (Please note: they accept cash or check only)
